baseline: retained independent room, original bytes from PILOT_AB_PROTOCOL_20260929.json
combination_rule: Combine the final prescribed numeric-feedback pose proposal with the single prescribed appearance proposal; never choose a pose arm or appearance trial after looking at its score
appearance_scope: Static geometric textile folds and neutral vent contrast only; preserve all canonical furniture poses and rigid dimensions in appearance-only group
metrics: frozen two-cabinet IoU and contour distance
source-image regional appearance residuals on predeclared bedding and vent regions
appearance_metric: Mean absolute log luminance ratio and mean RGB absolute difference, same camera/resolution/exposure; in-sample diagnostic, not physical reflectance accuracy
failures: Retain failed groups and full 5-group inventory. Do not replace failed final-round proposals with earlier or better-scoring ones.
attribution: Combined differences cannot be attributed to an individual mechanism; component groups are retained
scope: One development scene only. Not three-video benchmark, physical parameter recovery or SOTA
